description: Refused since 2026-11-19, without calling the canister: a deal's invite code is the buyer's way in only, and an AI agent never redeems it. To give this bot access to a deal, the buyer joins themselves on propxchain.com and connects it from the deal page. Kept so existing clients get a clear answer.

botName.description: Display name shown to participants in the bot list (e.g. "Claude Desktop", "Marc's assistant"). Max 64 characters.

inviteCode.description: Transaction invite code, format TX-XXXX-XXXX. The user gets this from the transaction page on propxchain.com.

name: propxchain_join_transaction_as_bot
